name: torn-tail
description: The engaged/spawn-intended/spawned records are intact; the process crashed mid-write of the fourth record, leaving a torn (partial, unparseable) tail entry. `durableSeq()` must resume from max(intact seq)+1, never trusting an in-memory counter or the torn entry's own claimed seq.

events.reason: process crashed after fsync of record 3 but mid-write of record 4 — a JSONL torn line, not a parseable record

expected.note: record 4 is discarded wholesale (JSONL torn-tail tolerance, design §6.2); durableSeq is max(intact seq)+1 = 4, not 5 — the torn record's claimed seq is never trusted
